result.answer:
All four services report an error rate of **0.00** across every 5-second bucket in the last 30 minutes. There is no ranking to produce — none of the services (frontend, customer, driver, route) generated any errors during this window.

This could mean:
- The HotRod load generator is not currently running, so there is no traffic to produce errors.
- Or the Jaeger SPM metrics backend has no error-tagged spans ingested in this period.

To confirm traffic is flowing at all, you may want to check call rates first (`get_service_call_rates`) — if those are also zero, the generator is simply not active.
